style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Mirrorball Potted 1ft 3 Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Get ready to sparkle this season with this 37cm artificial mirrorball potted Christmas tree—a bold blend of festive charm and glam style. Nestled in a dazzling mirrorball-inspired pot, this mini tree is decked out with lush, lifelike greenery that brings the magic of the holidays to any space. Whether you re styling a cosy nook, brightening up your office desk, or creating a standout table centrepiece, this tree brings instant holiday joy with a glittering twist. With zero maintenance required, it’s all shine and no stress. Modern, merry, and made to shine—this mirrorball potted Christmas tree is the ultimate holiday statement for those who love a little glam with their greenery. Pot Dims: D11.5xH9.5cm.
